workflow: A state-restoration interface accepts a value of an unsupported non-integer type without validating it.
The restoration logic passes that value to arithmetic intended for integer state.
The arithmetic path assumes the state is an integer and triggers an internal assertion when the assumption is false.
The operation terminates with an assertion failure instead of returning a recoverable type error.
summary: Unchecked state type reaches integer-only restoration logic
decision_reason: No existing cluster matches this specific workflow of missing type validation followed by an integer-assumption assertion; the nearby unchecked-state cluster concerns treating a wrong-type field as a mapping and crashing during lookup, which is materially different.
